name: legacy-relight-preview
description: Quick relight of a compiled legacy map for checking the whole chain (tools/quality/legacy_bsp_relight.py --quality legacy-relight-preview): the legacy-relight outputs at preview cost: a 2048 atlas at 256 samples with Blender's default light paths, a PRBV at 4 m, radiosity patches of 2 m and SDFV voxels of 0.5 m. Not for judging light quality.
